diagnostics.finding: The 8 native and 1 production pilot checks completed successfully. The original local server handles were missing after the environment transition, and connection refusal confirmed stopped listeners. Fresh servers on the same ports were independently byte-verified before any full browser job began.

numericalRegression.finding: Direct quadratic roots lost a valid interior extremum with near-zero cubic coefficients, allowing an interior fold or nonpositive attenuation between positive endpoints. A failing regression reproduced it. Stable paired roots now retain the extremum for positive and negative tiny cubic terms; actual UI and REST reject the invalid settings without source/assets/history publication.
